description.value: The Renfrew Branch is part of Vancouver Public Library's network of neighbourhood branches, serving the Renfrew-Collingwood area of East Vancouver. Housed in a two-storey civic building, it offers a welcoming public space in a predominantly residential part of the city. Touring cyclists routing through East Vancouver's quieter streets will find it a convenient and accessible stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned only a Cloudflare bot-verification stub, making it effectively a fetch failure; all amenity fields must rely on OSM tags alone. OSM confirms an active public library branch (amenity=library, operator=Vancouver Public Library, access=yes, opening hours present) supporting confirmed_open=true. The OSM tag internet_access=wlan hints at Wi-Fi but per instructions cannot be treated as authoritative without website confirmation, so all amenities are marked null.
concerns: Website fetch returned a Cloudflare security verification stub rather than page content; all amenity fields are unverifiable and set to null.
pre_enrichment_exclude was flagged true with reason 'prefetch_failed_stub' — overridden here as this is a confirmed real, open public institution.
OSM tag internet_access=wlan suggests Wi-Fi availability but could not be confirmed via website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, publicly accessible municipal library branch operated by Vancouver Public Library — a legitimate and useful stop for touring cyclists. The pre-enrichment exclusion flag reflects only a website fetch failure, not grounds for directory exclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Contact fields (phone, website, address) could not be corroborated against website content due to the Cloudflare fetch block; contact_confirmed fields set to null accordingly.
